annotations.selectedText: Displays the generated Markdown companion during manual review.
annotations.comment: Is this true always? Or is this just when gitignore isn't on?
More broadly, how is this different than the "Authored design files" store?

decisions.rationale: The review brief preserves one canonical communication standard across skills, host integration, and CLI guidance; executor and reviewer guidance checks coherent responsibilities and comparable peers.
The authored elements retain the CLI package with separate runtime and viewer siblings; the runtime reads source and serves the browser without making the browser a YAML reader.
The worked journey covers explicit feedback and contribution reconciliation, exact-input human approval, renewed review after input changes, and archive retention without importing old approval.
